section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for the present study, which consisted of 142 undergraduate women recruited from an Introductory Psychology class. The mean age was 18.68 years, and 86.9% of those who indicated ethnicity were Caucasian. Body Mass Index (BMI) was self-reported, with a mean BMI of 22.22.
